<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>App Page Motion Studio — ColorOS 17 & iOS 26 Edition</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #07090e;
  --card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --accent: #38bdf8;
  --accent-2: #818cf8;
  --text: #f8fafc;
  --muted: #94a3b8;
  --dur: 0.54s;
}
*, *::before, *::after {
  margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
html, body {
  width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: hidden;
  background: var(--bg);
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(56,189,248,0.065), transparent 36%),
                    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%, rgba(129,140,248,0.065), transparent 36%);
  color: var(--text);
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 28px 16px 64px;
}

/* Header */
header { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto 28px; text-align: center; }
.badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(56,189,248,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.22); color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.7px; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.live-dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #22c55e; animation: pulse 1.6s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.35} }

header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 4.5vw, 36px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.5px; margin-bottom: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 35%, #94a3b8 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
header p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; max-width: 580px; margin: 0 auto 20px; line-height: 1.55; }

/* Toolbar */
.toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; }
.pill-group {
  display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); padding: 4px; border-radius: 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.filter-btn, .speed-btn {
  background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--muted);
  padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;
}
.filter-btn.active, .speed-btn.active {
  background: rgba(56,189,248,0.16); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600;
}

/* Grid & Cards */
.grid {
  max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 18px;
}
.card {
  min-width: 0; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 22px; padding: 18px 16px 20px;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer;
}
.card.is-focused {
  border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.45);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(56,189,248,0.22);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045);
}
.card.hidden { display: none; }

/* Phone Mockup */
.phone-frame {
  width: 196px; height: 336px; background: #0c1018; border-radius: 28px;
  border: 3.5px solid #1d2434; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 14px; perspective: 950px;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}
.phone-notch {
  position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 50px; height: 12px; background: #040609; border-radius: 20px; z-index: 30; pointer-events: none;
}

/* App Screens */
.screen {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 28px 12px 14px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; backface-visibility: hidden;
  transition-property: transform, opacity, filter, border-radius, clip-path;
  transition-duration: var(--dur);
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}
.screen-home { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #121826 0%, #0b0f17 100%); z-index: 1; }
.screen-detail { background: linear-gradient(165deg, #162033 0%, #0e1422 100%); z-index: 2; box-shadow: -8px 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }

/* UI Skeleton inside Phone */
.app-hdr { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.app-ttl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.av-dot { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#38bdf8,#818cf8); }
.banner {
  height: 68px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 9px; margin-bottom: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56,189,248,0.2), rgba(129,140,248,0.2));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
}
.sk { height: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.24); width: 65%; margin-bottom: 5px; }
.sk.s { width: 40%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); margin-bottom: 0; }
.item {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 7px;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease;
}
.item.tap { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.24); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.55); transform: scale(0.93); }
.ico {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56,189,248,0.35), rgba(129,140,248,0.35));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.back-p { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.hero {
  height: 98px; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#0284c7,#6366f1);
  padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
}
.htag { align-self: flex-start; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; }
.dbtn { margin-top: auto; width: 100%; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: #07090e; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }

/* Custom Image Layer */
.custom-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; z-index: 15; display: none; background: #090c14; }
.has-custom .custom-img { display: block; }

.state-pill {
  position: absolute; bottom: 9px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: rgba(7,9,14,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  padding: 2.5px 10px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--muted); z-index: 40; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none;
}

/* Card Info */
.card-info { width: 100%; text-align: left; }
.card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.cat-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(56,189,248,0.1); color: var(--accent); white-space: nowrap; }
.card-desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.48; }

/* =========================================
   STUDIO DETAIL VIEW
   ========================================= */
.studio-page {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(7,9,14,0.97); z-index: 200;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 18px 16px 40px;
  overflow-y: auto; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translateY(20px);
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
}
.studio-page.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateY(0); }
.studio-bar { width: 100%; max-width: 600px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.btn-ghost {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  color: #fff; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 11px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-reset {
  background: rgba(244,63,94,0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(244,63,94,0.3);
  color: #fb7185; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: none;
}
.btn-reset.show { display: inline-block; }

.phone-frame.studio-phone { width: 236px; height: 410px; border-radius: 34px; border: 4px solid #242c3d; margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.hint-pill { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 20px; }

.studio-box {
  width: 100%; max-width: 480px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 22px; padding: 22px; text-align: center;
}
.studio-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin: 8px 0; }
.studio-desc { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.cta-btn {
  width: 100%; padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #6366f1); color: #fff;
  font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -6px rgba(14,165,233,0.45);
}

/* =========================================
   UPLOAD MODAL
   ========================================= */
.modal-bg {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(4,6,10,0.85); z-index: 300;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.modal-bg.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.modal-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 430px; background: #101522; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius: 24px; padding: 22px; position: relative;
  transform: scale(0.94); transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
}
.modal-bg.open .modal-card { transform: scale(1); }
.modal-hdr { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.close-x { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; }
.up-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin: 16px 0 20px; }
.up-box {
  height: 175px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(56,189,248,0.35);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 10px;
  cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.up-box.ok { border-style: solid; border-color: #22c55e; }
.up-prev { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: none; }
.up-box.ok .up-prev { display: block; }
.up-tag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 7px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: rgba(7,9,14,0.88); padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 99px;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #22c55e; display: none; white-space: nowrap;
}
.up-box.ok .up-tag { display: block; }
.check-btn {
  width: 100%; padding: 13px; border-radius: 13px; border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8, #818cf8); color: #07090e;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
}
.check-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.loader {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(16,21,34,0.96); border-radius: 24px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: 0.2s; z-index: 20;
}
.loader.on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.spin { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 3px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.2); border-top-color: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; animation: sp 0.75s linear infinite; }
@keyframes sp { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* =========================================
   FRAMELESS EDGE-TO-EDGE FULLSCREEN VIEW
   ========================================= */
.frameless-full {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  background: #05070b; z-index: 400; overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: scale(0.97);
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
}
.frameless-full.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: scale(1); }
.frameless-stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; perspective: 1100px; overflow: hidden; }
.frameless-stage .screen { padding: 48px 20px 28px; }
.frameless-stage .app-ttl { font-size: 18px; }
.frameless-stage .banner { height: 130px; border-radius: 18px; }
.frameless-stage .item { padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; }
.frameless-stage .hero { height: 180px; border-radius: 20px; }
.frameless-stage .dbtn { padding: 14px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px; }

.exit-full-btn {
  position: fixed; top: 18px; right: 18px; z-index: 450;
  background: rgba(7,9,14,0.72); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
.full-status-pill {
  position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 450;
  background: rgba(7,9,14,0.78); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px); pointer-events: none;
}

/* =========================================
   22 SMOOTH & PROFESSIONAL TRANSITIONS
   ========================================= */
/* 1. ColorOS 17 Icon Launch (NEW FLAGSHIP) */
[data-anim="coloros17-icon"] .screen { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.95, 0.28, 1.04); }
[data-anim="coloros17-icon"] .screen-detail {
  opacity: 0;
  transform-origin: 18% 58%;
  transform: translate3d(-44px, 34px, 0) scale(0.18);
  border-radius: 44px;
}
[data-anim="coloros17-icon"].is-in .screen-detail {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  border-radius: 0px;
}
[data-anim="coloros17-icon"].is-in .screen-home {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  filter: brightness(0.65);
}

/* 2. iOS 26 Fluid Zoom (NEW FLAGSHIP) */
[data-anim="ios26-fluid"] .screen { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); }
[data-anim="ios26-fluid"] .screen-detail {
  opacity: 0;
  transform-origin: 50% 62%;
  transform: scale(0.68) translateY(24px);
  border-radius: 36px;
}
[data-anim="ios26-fluid"].is-in .screen-detail {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  border-radius: 0px;
}
[data-anim="ios26-fluid"].is-in .screen-home {
  opacity: 0.35;
  transform: scale(1.06);
}

/* 3. iOS Parallax Slide */
[data-anim="ios-slide"] .screen-detail { transform: translateX(101%); }
[data-anim="ios-slide"].is-in .screen-detail { transform: translateX(0%); }
[data-anim="ios-slide"].is-in .screen-home { transform: translateX(-28%) scale(0.96); filter: brightness(0.6); }

/* 4. Material Shared Axis */
[data-anim="material-axis"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(38px); }
[data-anim="material-axis"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
[data-anim="material-axis"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-24px); }

/* 5. Silk Smooth Glide */
[data-anim="silk-glide"] .screen { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }
[data-anim="silk-glide"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(52px) scale(0.98); }
[data-anim="silk-glide"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1); }
[data-anim="silk-glide"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0.25; transform: scale(0.94); }

/* 6. Glass Sheet Stack (NEW) */
[data-anim="glass-stack"] .screen-detail { transform: translateY(102%) scale(0.96); border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; }
[data-anim="glass-stack"].is-in .screen-detail { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); border-radius: 0; }
[data-anim="glass-stack"].is-in .screen-home { transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.91); opacity: 0.5; border-radius: 20px; }

/* 7. Simple Crossfade */
[data-anim="simple-fade"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; }
[data-anim="simple-fade"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; }
[data-anim="simple-fade"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; }

/* 8. Simple Lift Fade */
[data-anim="simple-up"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); }
[data-anim="simple-up"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
[data-anim="simple-up"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-16px); }

/* 9. Soft Scale & Glide (NEW) */
[data-anim="soft-scale-glide"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(26px) scale(0.95); }
[data-anim="soft-scale-glide"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1); }
[data-anim="soft-scale-glide"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-18px) scale(0.98); }

/* 10. Glass Blur Dissolve */
[data-anim="blur-fade"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; filter: blur(12px); transform: scale(1.04); }
[data-anim="blur-fade"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0px); transform: scale(1); }
[data-anim="blur-fade"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; filter: blur(8px); }

/* 11. Bottom Sheet Modal */
[data-anim="bottom-sheet"] .screen-detail { top: 24px; border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; transform: translateY(104%); }
[data-anim="bottom-sheet"].is-in .screen-detail { transform: translateY(0%); }
[data-anim="bottom-sheet"].is-in .screen-home { transform: scale(0.92) translateY(6px); border-radius: 18px; filter: brightness(0.55); }

/* 12. Depth Scale Zoom */
[data-anim="depth-zoom"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.82); }
[data-anim="depth-zoom"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
[data-anim="depth-zoom"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.12); }

/* 13. Card Expand Pop */
[data-anim="card-pop"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(42px) scale(0.86); border-radius: 24px; }
[data-anim="card-pop"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); border-radius: 0px; }
[data-anim="card-pop"].is-in .screen-home { transform: scale(0.94); filter: brightness(0.6); }

/* 14. Spring Bounce Entry */
[data-anim="spring-bounce"] .screen { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.45, 0.64, 1); }
[data-anim="spring-bounce"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.88) translateY(28px); }
[data-anim="spring-bounce"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
[data-anim="spring-bounce"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92); }

/* 15. Diagonal Slide Wipe (NEW) */
[data-anim="diagonal-wipe"] .screen-detail { clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 100% 100%); }
[data-anim="diagonal-wipe"].is-in .screen-detail { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
[data-anim="diagonal-wipe"].is-in .screen-home { transform: scale(0.96); filter: brightness(0.65); }

/* 16. Curtain Wipe Reveal */
[data-anim="curtain-wipe"] .screen-detail { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 100%); }
[data-anim="curtain-wipe"].is-in .screen-detail { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0%); }
[data-anim="curtain-wipe"].is-in .screen-home { transform: translateX(-18%); filter: brightness(0.65); }

/* 17. Smooth Accordion Lift (NEW) */
[data-anim="accordion-lift"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(56px) scaleY(0.92); }
[data-anim="accordion-lift"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scaleY(1); }
[data-anim="accordion-lift"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(-20px); }

/* 18. 3D Perspective Turn */
[data-anim="flip-3d"] .screen-detail { opacity: 0; transform-origin: right center; transform: rotateY(-65deg) translateX(36px); }
[data-anim="flip-3d"].is-in .screen-detail { opacity: 1; transform: rotateY(0deg) translateX(0); }
[data-anim="flip-3d"].is-in .screen-home { opacity: 0.25; transform-origin: left center; transform: rotateY(35deg) scale(0.92); }

/* 19. Swipe Card Deck */
[data-anim="swipe-deck"] .screen-detail { transform: translateX(105%) rotate(6deg); }
[data-anim="swipe-deck"].is-in .screen-detail { transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg); }
[data-anim="swipe-deck"].is-in .screen-home { transform: translateX(-22%) rotate(-4deg) scale(0.93); filter: brightness(0.6); }

/* 20. Circle Iris Expand */
[data-anim="circle-iris"] .screen-detail { clip-path: circle(0% at 50% 80%); }
[data-anim="circle-iris"].is-in .screen-detail { clip-path: circle(140% at 50% 80%); }
[data-anim="circle-iris"].is-in .screen-home { transform: scale(0.96); filter: brightness(0.7); }

/* 21. Elastic Side Drawer */
[data-anim="elastic-drawer"] .screen { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1.25, 0.5, 1); }
[data-anim="elastic-drawer"] .screen-detail { transform: translateX(102%); border-top-left-radius: 26px; border-bottom-left-radius: 26px; }
[data-anim="elastic-drawer"].is-in .screen-detail { transform: translateX(0); border-radius: 0; }
[data-anim="elastic-drawer"].is-in .screen-home { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.4; }

/* 22. Vertical Push Swap */

</style>
</head>

<script>
const transitions = [
  { id: "coloros17-icon", title: "ColorOS 17 Icon Launch", cat: "Professional", desc: "আইকনে ট্যাপ করার সাথে সাথে সেখান থেকে প্রসারিত হয়ে স্মুথভাবে পেজ ওপেন হবে এবং বের হওয়ার সময় আইকনে গুটিয়ে যাবে।" },
  { id: "ios26-fluid", title: "iOS 26 Fluid Zoom", cat: "Smooth", desc: "ফ্লুইড রাউন্ডেড কর্নার ও নরম স্কেল কার্ভে পেজ সামনে আসবে এবং আউট হওয়ার সময় হালকা ফ্লোটে মিলিয়ে যাবে।" },
  { id: "ios-slide", title: "iOS Parallax Slide", cat: "Professional", desc: "ডান দিক থেকে নতুন পেজ স্লাইড হয়ে ঢুকবে এবং পেছনের পেজ হালকা ডার্ক হয়ে সরবে।" },
  { id: "material-axis", title: "Material Shared Axis", cat: "Professional", desc: "মডার্ন অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অ্যাপের স্ট্যান্ডার্ড ট্রানজিশন—হালকা স্লাইডের সাথে স্মুথ অপাসিটি।" },
  { id: "silk-glide", title: "Silk Smooth Glide", cat: "Smooth", desc: "রেশমের মতো মোলায়েম গতিতে পেজ পরিবর্তন। চোখের জন্য অত্যন্ত আরামদায়ক।" },
  { id: "glass-stack", title: "Glass Sheet Stack", cat: "Smooth", desc: "লেয়ারড কার্ডের মতো ওপরের দিকে উঠে আসবে এবং পেছনের স্ক্রিন ডাবল-লেয়ার ডেপথ তৈরি করবে।" },
  { id: "simple-fade", title: "Simple Crossfade", cat: "Simple", desc: "একদম হালকা ও ক্লিন ফেইড ইন/আউট। দ্রুত পেজ পরিবর্তনের জন্য সেরা।" },
  { id: "simple-up", title: "Simple Lift Fade", cat: "Simple", desc: "সামান্য নিচ থেকে ওপরে উঠে ফেইড ইন হবে। মিনিমালিস্ট অ্যাপে দারুণ মানায়।" },
  { id: "soft-scale-glide", title: "Soft Scale & Glide", cat: "Simple", desc: "খুবই সূক্ষ্ম স্কেল ও হালকা গ্লাইড মোশন—ক্লিন ও হালকা অ্যাপের জন্য আদর্শ।" },
  { id: "blur-fade", title: "Glass Blur Dissolve", cat: "Smooth", desc: "সফট গ্লাস ব্লার ইফেক্টের মাধ্যমে আগের পেজ মিলিয়ে নতুন পেজ ফোকাসে আসবে।" },
  { id: "bottom-sheet", title: "Bottom Sheet Modal", cat: "Professional", desc: "নিচ থেকে কার্ডের মতো ওপরে উঠে আসবে, পেছনের স্ক্রিন সামান্য ভেতরে ঢুকে যাবে।" },
  { id: "depth-zoom", title: "Depth Scale Zoom", cat: "Dynamic", desc: "গভীরতা তৈরি করে জুম-ইন হয়ে পেজ ওপেন হবে এবং জুম-আউট হয়ে ফিরবে।" },
  { id: "card-pop", title: "Card Expand Pop", cat: "Smooth", desc: "লিস্টের কার্ডে ট্যাপ করলে সেটি প্রসারিত হয়ে ফুল-স্ক্রিন পেজে রূপ নেবে।" },
  { id: "spring-bounce", title: "Spring Bounce Entry", cat: "Dynamic", desc: "হালকা স্প্রিং বাউন্স ইফেক্টসহ প্রাণবন্ত পেজ এন্ট্রি।" },
  { id: "diagonal-wipe", title: "Diagonal Slide Wipe", cat: "Dynamic", desc: "কৌণিক (Diagonal) পলিগন ওয়াইপে নতুন পেজ স্মুথলি দৃশ্যমান হবে।" },
  { id: "curtain-wipe", title: "Curtain Wipe Reveal", cat: "Professional", desc: "পর্দা সরে যাওয়ার মতো নিখুঁত ক্লিপ-পাথ রিভিল ট্রানজিশন।" },
  { id: "accordion-lift", title: "Smooth Accordion Lift", cat: "Smooth", desc: "নিচ থেকে প্রসারিত হয়ে স্বাভাবিক উচ্চতায় সেট হবে।" },
  { id: "flip-3d", title: "3D Perspective Turn", cat: "Dynamic", desc: "ত্রিমাত্রিক (3D) অ্যাঙ্গেলে কার্ড ঘোরার মতো প্রিমিয়াম ট্রানজিশন।" },
  { id: "swipe-deck", title: "Swipe Card Deck", cat: "Dynamic", desc: "হালকা অ্যাঙ্গেলে কার্ড স্লাইড হয়ে নতুন পেজ সামনে চলে আসবে।" },
  { id: "circle-iris", title: "Circle Iris Expand", cat: "Smooth", desc: "নিচের সেন্টার থেকে বৃত্তাকারে ছড়িয়ে পুরো পেজ ওপেন হবে।" },
  { id: "elastic-drawer", title: "Elastic Side Drawer", cat: "Smooth", desc: "রাউন্ডেড কর্নার ও ইলাস্টিক গতিতে পাশ থেকে স্মুথভাবে পেজ ঢুকবে।" },
  { id: "push-vertical", title: "Vertical Push Swap", cat: "Professional", desc: "নিচ থেকে নতুন পেজ ওপরে উঠে আগের পেজকে ওপরের দিকে পুশ করবে।" }
];

const grid = document.getElementById('grid');
let activeCardIndex = -1;
let cardTimer = null;
let cardTimers = [];

// Render Cards
transitions.forEach((item, i) => {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'card';
  card.dataset.cat = item.cat;
  card.dataset.idx = i;
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="phone-frame" data-anim="${item.id}" id="p-${i}">
      <div class="phone-notch"></div>
      <div class="screen screen-home">
        <div class="app-hdr"><span class="app-ttl">Home</span><div class="av-dot"></div></div>
        <div class="banner"><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk s"></div></div>
        <div class="item tap-el"><div class="ico"></div><div style="flex:1"><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk s"></div></div></div>
        <div class="item"><div class="ico" style="background:rgba(129,140,248,0.22)"></div><div style="flex:1"><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk s"></div></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="screen screen-detail">
        <div><span class="back-p">← Back</span></div>
        <div class="hero"><span class="htag">PAGE</span><div><div class="sk" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85)"></div><div class="sk s" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"></div></div></div>
        <div class="sk" style="width:88%;margin-bottom:6px"></div>
        <div class="sk" style="width:65%"></div>
        <div class="dbtn">Action</div>
      </div>
      <div class="state-pill" id="st-${i}">Ready</div>
    </div>
    <div class="card-info">
      <div class="card-top"><h3 class="card-title">${item.title}</h3><span class="cat-badge">${item.cat}</span></div>
      <p class="card-desc">${item.desc}</p>
    </div>`;
  card.addEventListener('click', () => openStudio(item));
  card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => setFocusedCard(i));
  grid.appendChild(card);
});

// =========================================
// SINGLE-CARD FOCUS ENGINE (ZERO LAG)
// =========================================
function clearCardLoop() {
  cardTimers.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
  cardTimers = [];
  if (cardTimer) { clearInterval(cardTimer); cardTimer = null; }
}

function resetCardVisual(i) {
  if (i < 0) return;
  const p = document.getElementById(`p-${i}`);
  const st = document.getElementById(`st-${i}`);
  const cardEl = document.querySelector(`.card[data-idx="${i}"]`);
  if (p) p.classList.remove('is-in');
  if (st) { st.textContent = "Ready"; st.style.color = "#94a3b8"; }
  if (cardEl) cardEl.classList.remove('is-focused');
}

function playSingleCardCycle(i) {
  const p = document.getElementById(`p-${i}`);
  const st = document.getElementById(`st-${i}`);
  const tap = p.querySelector('.tap-el');

  p.classList.remove('is-in');
  st.textContent = "Home"; st.style.color = "#94a3b8";

  cardTimers.push(setTimeout(() => tap.classList.add('tap'), 350));
  cardTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    tap.classList.remove('tap');
    p.classList.add('is-in');
    st.textContent = "Page In →"; st.style.color = "#38bdf8";
  }, 650));
  cardTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    p.classList.remove('is-in');
    st.textContent = "← Page Out"; st.style.color = "#a78bfa";
  }, 2200));
  cardTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    st.textContent = "Home"; st.style.color = "#94a3b8";
  }, 2800));
}

function setFocusedCard(i) {
  if (activeCardIndex === i || studioPage.classList.contains('open')) return;
  resetCardVisual(activeCardIndex);
  clearCardLoop();

  activeCardIndex = i;
  const cardEl = document.querySelector(`.card[data-idx="${i}"]`);
  if (cardEl) cardEl.classList.add('is-focused');

  playSingleCardCycle(i);
  cardTimer = setInterval(() => playSingleCardCycle(i), 3300);
}

let scrollDebounce = null;
function detectCenterCard() {
  if (studioPage.classList.contains('open')) return;
  const visibleCards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card:not(.hidden)')];
  if (!visibleCards.length) return;

  const targetY = window.innerHeight * 0.48;
  let closestIdx = 0;
  let minDist = Infinity;

  visibleCards.forEach(c => {
    const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
    const center = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    const dist = Math.abs(center - targetY);
    if (dist < minDist) {
      minDist = dist;
      closestIdx = Number(c.dataset.idx);
    }
  });
  setFocusedCard(closestIdx);
}

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  clearTimeout(scrollDebounce);
  scrollDebounce = setTimeout(detectCenterCard, 180);
}, { passive: true });

setTimeout(() => setFocusedCard(0), 250);

// =========================================
// STUDIO DETAIL & FRAMELESS FULLSCREEN
// =========================================
const studioPage = document.getElementById('studioPage');
const studioPhone = document.getElementById('studioPhone');
const studioStatus = document.getElementById('studioStatus');
const fullOverlay = document.getElementById('fullOverlay');
const fullStage = document.getElementById('fullStage');
const fullStatus = document.getElementById('fullStatus');

let studioLoop = null;
let studioTimers = [];
let picInURL = null, picOutURL = null;

function clearStudioLoop() {
  studioTimers.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
  studioTimers = [];
  if (studioLoop) { clearInterval(studioLoop); studioLoop = null; }
}

function runStudioCycle() {
  const custom = Boolean(picInURL && picOutURL);
  const inTxt = custom ? "App Pic In" : "Home Screen";
  const outTxt = custom ? "App Pic Out" : "Next Page";

  studioPhone.classList.remove('is-in');
  fullStage.classList.remove('is-in');
  studioStatus.textContent = inTxt; fullStatus.textContent = inTxt;
  studioStatus.style.color = "#e2e8f0"; fullStatus.style.color = "#e2e8f0";

  const tap = studioPhone.querySelector('.tap-el');
  studioTimers.push(setTimeout(() => { if (!custom) tap.classList.add('tap'); }, 450));

  studioTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    tap.classList.remove('tap');
    studioPhone.classList.add('is-in');
    fullStage.classList.add('is-in');
    studioStatus.textContent = `In → ${outTxt}`;
    fullStatus.textContent = `In → ${outTxt}`;
    studioStatus.style.color = "#38bdf8"; fullStatus.style.color = "#38bdf8";
  }, 800));

  studioTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    studioPhone.classList.remove('is-in');
    fullStage.classList.remove('is-in');
    studioStatus.textContent = `Out → ${inTxt}`;
    fullStatus.textContent = `Out → ${inTxt}`;
    studioStatus.style.color = "#a78bfa"; fullStatus.style.color = "#a78bfa";
  }, 2500));

  studioTimers.push(setTimeout(() => {
    studioStatus.textContent = inTxt; fullStatus.textContent = inTxt;
    studioStatus.style.color = "#94a3b8"; fullStatus.style.color = "#94a3b8";
  }, 3150));
}

function startStudioLoop() {
  clearStudioLoop();
  runStudioCycle();
  studioLoop = setInterval(runStudioCycle, 3800);
}

function openStudio(item) {
  clearCardLoop();
  resetCardVisual(activeCardIndex);
  activeCardIndex = -1;

  document.getElementById('sTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('sCat').textContent = item.cat;
  document.getElementById('sDesc').textContent = item.desc;
  studioPhone.dataset.anim = item.id;
  fullStage.dataset.anim = item.id;

  studioPage.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  startStudioLoop();
}

document.getElementById('closeStudio').addEventListener('click', () => {
  studioPage.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  clearStudioLoop();
  detectCenterCard();
});

studioPhone.addEventListener('click', () => {
  fullOverlay.classList.add('open');
  startStudioLoop();
});
document.getElementById('exitFull').addEventListener('click', () => {
  fullOverlay.classList.remove('open');
});

// =========================================
// UPLOAD POPUP MODAL
// =========================================
const uploadModal = document.getElementById('uploadModal');
const runCheck = document.getElementById('runCheck');
const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
const resetDemo = document.getElementById('resetDemo');
let tmpIn = null, tmpOut = null;

document.getElementById('openModal').addEventListener('click', () => uploadModal.classList.add('open'));
document.getElementById('closeModal').addEventListener('click', () => uploadModal.classList.remove('open'));

function loadImg(file, type) {
  if (!file) return;
  const r = new FileReader();
  r.onload = e => {
    if (type === 'in') {
      tmpIn = e.target.result;
      document.getElementById('prevIn').src = tmpIn;
      document.getElementById('boxIn').classList.add('ok');
    } else {
      tmpOut = e.target.result;
      document.getElementById('prevOut').src = tmpOut;
      document.getElementById('boxOut').classList.add('ok');
    }
    runCheck.disabled = !(tmpIn && tmpOut);
  };
  r.readAsDataURL(file);
}

document.getElementById('inFile').addEventListener('change', e => loadImg(e.target.files[0], 'in'));
document.getElementById('outFile').addEventListener('change', e => loadImg(e.target.files[0], 'out'));

runCheck.addEventListener('click', () => {
  loader.classList.add('on');
  setTimeout(() => {
    picInURL = tmpIn; picOutURL = tmpOut;
    document.getElementById('sImgIn').src = picInURL;
    document.getElementById('sImgOut').src = picOutURL;
    document.getElementById('fImgIn').src = picInURL;
    document.getElementById('fImgOut').src = picOutURL;

    studioPhone.classList.add('has-custom');
    fullStage.classList.add('has-custom');
    resetDemo.classList.add('show');

    loader.classList.remove('on');
    uploadModal.classList.remove('open');
    startStudioLoop();
  }, 750);
});

resetDemo.addEventListener('click', () => {
  picInURL = null; picOutURL = null;
  studioPhone.classList.remove('has-custom');
  fullStage.classList.remove('has-custom');
  resetDemo.classList.remove('show');
  startStudioLoop();
});

// =========================================
// FILTER & SPEED CONTROLS
// =========================================
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    const f = btn.dataset.filter;
    document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.toggle('hidden', f !== 'all' && c.dataset.cat !== f);
    });
    resetCardVisual(activeCardIndex);
    activeCardIndex = -1;
    detectCenterCard();
  });
});

document.querySelectorAll('.speed-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.speed-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--dur', btn.dataset.speed);
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
